# Subway Seat for Hex list

Plain text, one colour per line as #hex and its name. Most palette tools will take a paste of it.

[Hex list](https://coolors.co) · [All ports and previews](https://oddurs.github.io/subway-seat/ports/txt/)

## Files

| Flavor | File | Where it goes |
|---|---|---|
| Subway Seat | [`subway-seat.txt`](subway-seat.txt) | anywhere; paste it where you need it |
| Subway Seat Tunnel | [`subway-seat-tunnel.txt`](subway-seat-tunnel.txt) | anywhere; paste it where you need it |
| Subway Seat Enamel | [`subway-seat-enamel.txt`](subway-seat-enamel.txt) | anywhere; paste it where you need it |

## Turn it on

**Subway Seat**, in Coolors, Figma plugins, or anything that takes pasted hex codes:

```sh
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat.txt | pbcopy
```

**Subway Seat Tunnel**, in Coolors, Figma plugins, or anything that takes pasted hex codes:

```sh
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat-tunnel.txt | pbcopy
```

**Subway Seat Enamel**, in Coolors, Figma plugins, or anything that takes pasted hex codes:

```sh
cut -d' ' -f1 subway-seat-enamel.txt | pbcopy
```


Generated by `build.py` from `palette.py`. Edit the port in `ports/`, not these files.
